bull_bear.body:
- Fully eroded net worth — Under 'Details of any change in Return on Net Worth' the Company states its 'net worth continues to stand fully eroded' — a structural solvency condition that has persisted rather than a one-year event, with return on equity and return on capital employed further impacted by the increase in loss during the year.
- Uncertainty over settlement of legacy NBFC litigation — Under MD&A 'Risks and Concerns' management states it 'sees uncertainty in such settlements as the present functioning is only limited to recovery of delinquent loan assets' — the outcome of old legal cases filed by and against the Company is outside its control and is the dominant swing factor.
- No operating business — income is non-operating only — 'During the year, the Company has earned other income only' and 'the gross income mainly comprises of interest income'. The stated business of advisory/consultancy has not commenced; directors are still only 'exploring the possibilities' of venturing into it, so there is no revenue engine to offset costs.
- Loss of the NBFC licence removed the historical business — 'Consequent to the surrender of the license of Non-Banking and Finance Company, and in consonance with the directions received from Reserve Bank of India, the Company has changed the business activities' — the entity's original regulated activity is gone and the replacement activity is not yet operating.
- Recovery risk on delinquent loan assets — The Company's present functioning is limited to recovering delinquent loan assets left over from the earlier NBFC business; realisation depends entirely on a book of already-defaulted borrowers, and the year's loss is stated as arising after 'write-offs/ provisions etc.'
- No employees on rolls — execution capacity — 'There was no employee on rolls of the Company as on March 31, 2026. However, there are 3 (three) persons on contractual engagement.' The Company has no permanent staff with which to build the advisory/consultancy business it says it is exploring.
- Macro / regulatory and tax environment — The Cautionary Statement names 'significant changes in political and economic environment in India, tax laws, and related costs' as the important developments that could affect the Company's operations.

business.body: Following the surrender of its Non-Banking Financial Company licence and in consonance with directions received from the Reserve Bank of India, the Company changed its business activities to providing advisory/consultancy services and reports as a single segment. In practice it is presently engaged in the recovery of delinquent loan assets and the settlement of old legal cases filed by and against the Company arising out of its earlier NBFC business, with directors still 'exploring the possibilities' of actually venturing into consultancy/advisory work. During FY 2025-26 the Company earned other income only, its gross income comprising mainly interest income, and it had no employees on rolls as at March 31, 2026 (three persons on contractual engagement).
